status_rules.PASS: The complete named scenario was met at (or above) its required evidence level, with exact test identifiers or a recorded command, and nothing in the row is left open.
status_rules.FAIL: Evidence exists and shows the required result is not met.
status_rules.BLOCKED: The row cannot run because a prerequisite outside this repository's code is missing (an approved model or embedder, a signing identity or notarised host, a real-hardware or human review, an external approval). Used sparingly: the P1 convention stands that unfinished implementation is NOT_RUN, not BLOCKED.
status_rules.NOT_RUN: No qualifying run was performed against the row. This includes rows whose implementation does not exist. Adjacent evidence that was not mapped to the row is named in the row and does not change the status.
status_rules.NOT_APPLICABLE: Reserved for optional-future cases with the disabled feature and reason named. Required cases never use it merely because implementation is unfinished. Nothing in this ledger uses it.
status_rules.PARTIAL: Retained, with the P1 definition: useful, named, executed evidence exists for part of the row (or the work item) while a stated part has not met its scenario or its evidence level. Every PARTIAL row states the gap. PARTIAL is kept only where the accepted P1 or P8 ledgers already used it, or where a retained packet or record names executed tests for part of the row.

properties.statement: Semantic mode never returns lexical hits as semantic success

Combined mode returns the exact keyword-mode lexical result with status partial for each known semantic unavailability: no_active_generation, stale_generation, incompatible_profile, incompatible_execution (query-side and recorded), incomplete_coverage, corrupt_state, query_not_embedded
A missing vector for an otherwise active generation is incomplete coverage (IncompleteSemanticCoverage), distinct from no generation
Empty query or empty authorized frontier gives deterministic no_match for every requested lane without reading semantic state
Unexpected errors are not hidden as unavailability (malformed query vector, storage error, unknown mode)
Exact exhaustive scoring over the complete authorized semantic frontier before retention; no frontier-size cap; per-lane hard maximum 200; final result limit default 10, hard maximum 50

Clauses, in the source's order: fresh enabled default versus saved off; scheduled quiet current result; manual Check Now while automatic is off; known available version retained when auto is disabled; no false Up to date on failed or never checked; update notice synchronised between General and the menu; no duplicate concurrent checks; separate update-transfer percentage from indexing progress; rejected bad signature, version or architecture and failed install preserving prior usable state; unavailable in-place installer routes safely to a release download with no success claim. Group NOT_RUN: General shows 'Check for updates ... This build has none', there is no auto-check preference, scheduler, menu row or progress UI. Adjacent (P33, record-stated, L1/L3, not re-run): signature, channel, replay and downgrade refusal against test-only keys and staging/journal transitions; production verification refuses every envelope (PACKAGED_TRUSTED_KEYS is empty); no signed or notarised package was built, installed or activated. The clause on rejection and failed install would be the first candidate for PARTIAL once an installer exists.
